title: Bayesian Data Scientist
description: Tomás Korenblit, Bayesian Data Scientist. Notes on books, ideas, and what I'm working on.
homeBio:
I'm a data scientist interested in causal inference, AI safety, and the history and philosophy of science. Right now I'm focused on AI safety. Lately that means measuring how LLMs forget in-context instructions: my paper on this is accepted at JAIIO 2026, and I recently finished BlueDot's Technical AI Safety course.

Feel free to send an email if you want to talk.
